summary: Tested ITEM A (login whitepaper link removal) and ITEM B (eMASS Control Information import) end-to-end on the public URL. Backend: 24/24 unit tests (test_emass_import.py + test_emass_fields.py) and 16/16 new live tests (tests/test_emass_import_live.py) pass. Frontend: every requested flow passed in Playwright. Checked: the login page no longer links to the whitepaper or demo video; /whitepaper and /demo-video still load and the public files return 200. Checked: the Workbench entry button and the control detail import link; sample download, upload and the report; review accept/reject per field and per control; the bulk buttons (accept safe, reject all, reset); the show-unchanged toggle; invalid and blocked fields have no Accept button; nothing is saved before Apply; Apply with a confirm dialog (AU-2 is reported as not saved because N/A Justification is missing); audit source 'eMASS import <file> (sha256 …)'; a second Apply returns 409; Resume keeps the decisions; Discard works; SCA, AO and ISSM are read-only (403); System Owner can edit; round trip gives 0 changes; malicious and non-xlsx files get a clean 422 toast and no session is created. ONE CRITICAL ENVIRONMENT/ROBUSTNESS ISSUE FOUND: the worker process was started before models.py gained EmassImport. The worker has no hot reload, so the nightly sandbox.demo_reset job (00:06) failed 3 times with ImportError. The demo was then unusable: POST /auth/demo-login returned 503 'The demo workspace is being prepared' with no automatic recovery. I restarted the worker and re-enqueued sandbox.demo_reset, and the demo recovered. The reset also regenerated all system IDs: LTP is now 3630fca0-4fb1-45d5-b020-a93156344bb4, and the old f47571aa… returns 404.

critical.issue: The worker (no hot reload) held a stale app.models without EmassImport. reset_demo_account → seed_phase4 → emass_fields.grounding → imports app.api.v1.workbench → app.api.v1/__init__ → emass_import.py → ImportError. The job reached max_attempts=3 and was marked failed. The org stayed in sandbox_status != 'ready', so demo-login returned 503 indefinitely. Fixed in this environment: supervisorctl restart worker + re-enqueued the job. Still needed: (a) restart the worker after model or migration changes (add this to the pod_bootstrap/deploy steps); (b) make a failed demo_reset recoverable (set sandbox_status back to ready or re-enqueue it automatically, and alert); (c) stop services.emass_fields.grounding importing the API layer (app.api.v1.workbench). Move _control_poams/_policies_for into a service module.

minor.issue: There is no row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE) on EmassImport, so two concurrent Apply calls could both pass the status=='review' check and apply twice. Also, the narrative save is not inside begin_nested like the plan and risk saves are.
It runs _current() once per row, which is several queries each. A 10,000-row file means N+1 queries. Batch-load the fields and narratives.

integration_issues.issue: The history table shows 'Accepted / rejected / undecided' but not the applied count. Example: an import shows 2 accepted while only 1 field was applied, because AU-2 failed the required-field rule. The spec asks the history to show applied counts.

The confirm dialog says 'Apply 2 accepted field(s)' even when one accepted field belongs to a control with a known required_issue and will certainly be rejected. Consider warning in the confirm text or excluding that field from the count.

issues: Breadcrumb shows 'LTP > Start > Systems' instead of '4 · Implement > Control Workbench > Import from eMASS'
The success toast overlaps the 'Acting as' header pill for a few seconds after upload
The column-mapping line in the report is one very long grey 11px paragraph that is hard to read; a small table or collapsible block would help

action_items: HIGH: Make sandbox.demo_reset failure recoverable. Today 3 failed attempts leave demo-login at 503 forever. Add an auto-retry or re-enqueue, or restore sandbox_status to 'ready' on failure.
HIGH: Restart the worker whenever models or migrations change (pod_bootstrap/deploy). Remove the services → api import (emass_fields.grounding importing app.api.v1.workbench).
Show applied_fields / failed_controls in the import history row.
Apply confirm: warn about accepted fields on controls with a required_issue.
Add a row lock on EmassImport in apply/discard/decide to stop a double apply.
Fix the breadcrumb on the eMASS import page.
critical_code_review_comments: emass_fields.grounding() imports app.api.v1.workbench. A service depending on the API layer pulls in every router at import time and broke the worker seed path. Move the helpers into services.
ei.apply: there is no SELECT FOR UPDATE on the import, so concurrent applies can race. The narrative write is not in a savepoint.
ei.build is N+1 per row (fields_for + narrative query). Batch it for files with up to 10k rows.

Things that are correct: file safety (PK magic, OLE/encrypted rejection, workbook.xml check, uncompressed-size and entry caps, keep_vba=False, read_only, data_only); SHA-256 stored; RBAC (implementation.write + _can_edit); the 409 on a re-apply; empty cells are treated as 'no value', never as a clear.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (one critical environment issue in the worker / demo reset)

seed_data_creation: Applied a few sample changes on LTP (AC-2 SLCM Frequency/Comments/Severity, AC-17 SLCM Method, etc.). Several imports were created and discarded or applied in the LTP history. Manually re-enqueued sandbox.demo_reset (job 749dabd8) after restarting the worker.

Demo-login is rate-limited to 30/h per IP; the live test falls back to password login. Audit list endpoint: GET /api/v1/audit-events?action=emass.plan_updated (not /api/v1/audit). After the first Apply in a reset period, AC-2 sample values match the stored ones, so they no longer show as changes.
rca of the issue: Demo outage: at 00:06 the scheduler ran sandbox.demo_reset in the worker process. The worker had been started at about 23:54, before models.py (23:57) and emass_import.py (23:59) were edited, and it does not hot reload. During reseeding, emass_fields.grounding lazily imported app.api.v1.workbench. That executed app/api/v1/__init__.py, which imported the new app.api.v1.emass_import, which did 'from app.models import EmassImport' against the stale cached app.models → ImportError. The job failed 3 times (max_attempts), and the demo org was left not 'ready', so demo-login returned 503. Fix applied: sudo supervisorctl restart worker, then enqueue('sandbox.demo_reset') → succeeded, and demo-login returned 200.
